services.name: The Great Whistler Walking Tour
services.desc: 1.5 hour walking tour hits Whistler's must-see landmarks, significant works of art, and offers jaw-dropping scenery. As you see the sites and hear the stories, your local guide will give you an insiders view on all things Whistler. This tour also includes great recommendations and discounts! 1.5 Hours Adult (Ages 13+) - CA$59.99 Child (12 and under) - The perfect mix of scenery, art & culture · 1.5 hour guided tour · Available May-Oct · CA$54.99

services.name: Whistler Distillery Tour & Tasting Experience
services.desc: Relax, leave the car at home and let us take you on a hassle free evening to Montis Distilling in Whistler, BC. This 2 hour tour will take you deep into the local neighborhood of Function Junction where you'll enjoy a guided tour of the facility, tastings of all available products and locally curated cheese + charcuterie. This tour also includes comfortable return transportation from your accommodation! Availability Fridays & Saturdays at 5.30pm (2 hours avg. duration) Or call 604 967 3509 to create your own itinerary! Includes Pickup from Whistler Hotels & Accommodations Adult - Choose an option or call 604 967 3509 to create your own itinerary! · CA$99.99

services.name: Full Whistler Sightseeing Tour
services.desc: fully guided Sightseeing Tour showcases everything the world class resort town of Whistler BC has to offer! An extremely scenic adventure to discover Whistler's most picturesque locations, Olympic venues, historic sites & hidden local artisan districts. This tour has something for everyone! 3 Hours Average Adult (Ages 13+) - CA$109.99 Child (12 and under) - Available year-round · 3 hour guided tour with transport · Discover all of Whistler · CA$124.99

services.name: Private Whistler Sightseeing Tour
services.desc: fully guided Private Sightseeing Tour showcases everything the world-class resort town of Whistler BC has to offer in just one morning or afternoon! An extremely scenic adventure to discover Whistler's most picturesque locations, Olympic venues, historic sites and natural recreation areas. Bear, eagle and other wildlife are often spotted over the warmer months! 3 Hours Includes Pickup from Whistler Hotels & Accommodations Starting at - CA$499.99 per Available year-round · 3 hour guided tour with transport · See it all in comfort · From CA$549.99
